title: Nakuru — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nakuru: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nakuru has a population of 570,000. A city in the Great Rift Valley, known for Lake Nakuru National Park and its flamingo populations. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 115 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
